result.summary: The new metadata protection has a reproducible numeric-host bypass. 60 targeted tests passed; two required writes unavailable in the read-only sandbox.

findings.title: Reject alternate numeric spellings of blocked metadata addresses
findings.body: InstanceConfig(url="http://2852039166", enabled=True) passes this validator, as does http://0xA9FEA9FE. The helper treats ipaddress parsing failures as allowed hostnames (triggarr/web/validation.py:167–173). HTTPX preserves these hosts, and local socket.getaddrinfo with AI_NUMERICHOST resolves both to 169.254.169.254 without DNS. startup.py:155 passes the accepted URL into ArrClient, whose connection validation issues an HTTP request. Thus a configured URL can still reach the metadata address this new check explicitly promises to block; this is not DNS rebinding.
findings.recommendation: Normalize or reject legacy numeric IPv4 representations before accepting the hostname fallback, apply the blocked-address checks to the normalized address, and add model-level regression tests for decimal, hexadecimal, and octal metadata-address variants.

next_steps: Close the numeric-host bypass and rerun configuration and validation tests in a writable test environment.
